example_sentences_in_bangla: তার হাতে কালি লেগেছে, আর কেউ তাকে বিশ্বাস করবে না।
এই ঘটনার পর তার হাতে কালি পড়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has ink on his hands; no one will trust him anymore.
After this incident, there's a stain on his reputation.
history: Originating from the imagery of ink stains on hands from writing or clerical work, symbolizing indelible guilt or wrongdoing in everyday Bengali life.
note: The idiom draws from the cultural context of manual writing with ink, implying a permanent mark of shame.
